about.headline: About T-Mat Global
body: T-Mat Global is a DPIIT Recognized Startup under the Startup India Initiative, Government of India (CERT: DIPP248437 | CIN: U62010PN2026PTC252419). Founded by Sainath Shivaji Mitalakar — former DevOps Engineer at T-Mobile USA, AWS Certified, Top 25 Global DevOps Thought Leader.

We deliver high-impact DevOps engineering, cloud infrastructure, AI systems, software development and strategic IT consulting to enterprises across the US, UAE, UK and beyond. Startup agility meets enterprise operational maturity.
Our engineering teams are built for precision. Our processes are built for accountability. Our culture is built around one unwavering commitment — outcomes that move the needle.
Headquartered in India. Engineered for the world. Operating across every major time zone.
